hook: Never seek justice from a crowd. A mob does not want truth; it wants blood.
description:
Never seek justice from a crowd. A mob does not want truth; it wants blood.

Never seek justice from a crowd. A mob does not want truth; it wants blood. The collective mind is blind, hysterical, and easily guided by demagogues. They will crown you king on Sunday and cheer your public execution by Friday morning. A crowd possesses zero conscience. Responsibility is diluted across thousands of screaming faces, allowing cowards to commit atrocities they would never dare alone. The most dangerous illusion is believing public consensus equals moral righteousness. Never adjust your compass by the roar of the arena. Stand alone, or be swallowed by the herd.
